Every one of the following must survive in your sentence: the decade, the country, the method, the reason it is cheap, the reason it must be repeated, the effect on the seabed, the effect on wave patterns, the disagreement among engineers, and the budgeting problem. Coastal erosion along the Belgian shore has been managed since the 1970s mainly by pumping sand from offshore banks onto beaches. Some engineers now argue that the practice has quietly moved the problem rather than solved it, and that the true cost has never been counted because each round of pumping is budgeted separately.
